fds_2025_title: Science Feast 2025 : Come defy our cardboard AI !
fds_2025_background_paragraph_1: I participated to the 2025 edition of the Fête de la Science at the University of Strasbourg. I animated a stand destined to teach the concepts of artificial intelligence using no computed of any device of any sort. Our stand was called Viens défier nos IA en carton ! (come defy our cardboard AI).
